description: Review F15/CF2 (consensus testing+spec). mix test --cover now gates BOTH matrix legs at threshold 83: native OTP 28 measures 83.73%, classic OTP 26 measures 83.68% (measured 2026-07-24 at eb259ac) — different totals because OTP-conditional code paths differ per leg, and the mix.exs comment/baseline never says which leg the 83.05% provenance number came from. Document per-leg provenance next to the threshold and either widen headroom or add a ratchet policy note. Related: the 90% ratchet follow-up from specled_-6v6.

comments.text:
ADMISSION VERIFICATION (specled_-k6s, 2026-07-27)
Cold fresh-context verifier run against the epic base tree (feat/specled_-td7-self-identifying-descriptors @ e81f9f98).

VERDICT: still_applicable   EFFORT: small
Mandate confirmed still applicable as written; no narrowing needed.

== SCOPED REMAINING WORK ==
All of it. Three concrete edits, no discovery needed:

1. mix.exs:10 — add a comment block immediately above `test_coverage: [summary: [threshold: 83]],` that records per-leg provenance. It must name each CI matrix leg by (elixir, otp) pair as declared at .github/workflows/specs.yml:97-101 — native leg Elixir 1.19.5 / OTP 28.3.1, classic leg Elixir 1.18.4 / OTP 26.2.5 — give each leg's measured total with the commit + date it was measured at, and state WHY the totals differ (OTP-conditional branches: `SpecLedEx.Coverage.Snapshot.runtime_mode/0` returns :native on OTP >= 27 and :classic below, so a different set of lines is reachable per leg). The ticket's figures are native 83.73% / classic 83.68% measured 2026-07-24 at eb259ac; either re-measure and date-stamp fresh numbers for this tree, or carry them forward with the eb259ac stamp explicit so the number is not read as current.

2. .github/workflows/specs.yml:124-126 — the surviving prose ("just below the measured 83.05% true coverage as of 2026-07-23 epic bef5400") is the leg-unattributed, now-superseded number the ticket names. Either delete it in favour of a one-line pointer to the mix.exs comment (preferred — keeps one source of truth), or bring it into agreement with the per-leg record. Do not leave two divergent provenance stamps.

3. Resolve the headroom disposition — pick ONE and write it down next to the threshold:
   (a) widen headroom by lowering the threshold below the classic-leg total by a stated margin (e.g. 82, stating the intended margin and why 0.68pp was judged too thin), OR
   (b) keep 83 and add an explicit ratchet policy note: the invariant is "threshold tracks the LOWER of the two legs' measured totals", the current lower leg is classic/OTP 26, the accepted margin is <1pp, and the raise-toward-90 work is unfiled. If (b) is chosen, also file the missing 90% ratchet ticket (`bw list --grep "ratchet"` shows it was never created despite specled_-6v6's promise) and reference its id from the note, otherwise the note points at nothing.

Optional but consistent with repo practice: a CHANGELOG.md entry under the release heading.

== EXPECTED TOUCHES ==
mix.exs, .github/workflows/specs.yml, .spec/specs/package.spec.md, .spec/specs/compiler_tracer.spec.md, CHANGELOG.md

== RISK NOTES ==
REALIZATION HASH: no risk. .spec/realization_hashes.json has exactly one top-level bucket, "api_boundary", and `grep -n "MixProject" .spec/realization_hashes.json` exits 1 — mix.exs is not hashed, so inserting comment lines at mix.exs:10 cannot shift any hashed api_boundary region. No spec requirement id changes.

BRANCH GUARD (the real cost, and the main cross-ticket coupling): mix.exs is a surface member of TWO subjects — .spec/specs/compiler_tracer.spec.md:32 (`  - mix.exs`) and .spec/specs/package.spec.md:60 (`  - mix.exs`). `branch_guard_missing_subject_update` defaults to :error (lib/specled_ex/branch_check.ex:17), so a mix.exs edit with no co-update to BOTH spec files fails `mix spec.check`. specled_-6v6's completion record confirms exactly this: "two branch_guard_missing_subject_update findings on mix.exs/snapshot_test.exs resolved by co-updating package.spec.md, compiler_tracer.spec.md". Both spec files ALREADY carry the incidental-touch carve-out prose for this exact edit shape — compiler_tracer.spec.md:15-19 and package.spec.md:19-23 both say an edit to `test_coverage: [summary: [threshold: ...]]` "legitimately touches this subject's tracked surface without reflecting any change to" the subject — so the carve-out text does not need to be written again, but the guard still demands a diff in those files in this PR range, or a `Spec-Drift: branch_guard_missing_subject_update=info` trailer (lib/specled_ex/branch_check/trailer.ex:48 maps the `test_only` preset; a bare code=severity trailer is the documented escape per branch_check.ex:107 pattern). In a single combined PR, any of specled_-4pl / specled_-z5t / specled_-ozm / specled_-yds editing package.spec.md, and specled_-asb editing compiler_tracer.spec.md, would incidentally satisfy the guard — but do not rely on it; those tickets edit skills/docs and test files and may never open the .spec/specs file. Coordinate: whoever lands last should confirm the guard is clear.

.github/workflows/specs.yml is bound to NO subject (`grep -rn "\.github" .spec/specs/*.spec.md` → no hits), so editing it alone triggers no co-update requirement.

MEASUREMENT RISK: the 83.73/83.68 figures are stamped at eb259ac (2026-07-24). This tree is 10 commits past main on feat/specled_-td7-self-identifying-descriptors with lib/ and test/ changes (17b63ff6, d97be893, 31136e09, b0e9027c…), so those totals are stale for this tree. Re-measuring exactly is NOT possible on this host: local OTP is 27 (`erlang:system_info(otp_release)` → "27"), which matches neither the native leg (OTP 28.3.1) nor the classic leg (OTP 26.2.5). OTP 27 does select :native mode (>= 27), so a local run approximates the native leg only; the classic-leg number can only come from CI. Recommendation for the orchestrator: do NOT require a fresh classic-leg measurement as an acceptance condition — accept date+commit-stamped historical numbers, or read the two legs off a CI run of this PR after it is opened.

Measuring at all requires `mix test --include integration --cover` (full suite, the expensive form) — do not schedule that concurrently with other agents.

NO ORDERING DEPENDENCY on any other ticket in the set. Not blocked by, and does not block, specled_-26g or specled_-xkn.1 (its epic siblings) — they touch test/specled_ex/coverage/store_test.exs and lib/specled_ex/coverage/store.ex respectively, disjoint from this ticket's files. Sibling specled_-dn4.12 also touches coverage code but not mix.exs or specs.yml.

CHANGELOG.md contention: essentially every ticket in the 22-ticket set will add a release-note line to the same section. Not a semantic conflict, but expect textual collisions; have one agent own the CHANGELOG section, or land entries in a single pass at the end.
